digest.component_or_area: code review impact model (code-v3 → code-v4 redesign)
propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards verifier prod_impact/trigger_likelihood judgments for maint-lane findings, causing test findings to score ~0.30 (advisory@0.95 threshold) despite load-bearing user-reach
A contract declaring 'stale>0 alone allowed' shipped with a test asserting 'stale=0' (contradiction) was not flagged because the contract-contradicting-assertion antipattern does not exist in code-v3

Code-v4 introduces lane-scoped impact formula: serious maint×1.0 undamped, moderate maint×prod_impact (high/med=1.0, low=0.6, none=0.5), debt binary churn-amplifier-only, with consequence-lane-only reversibility floor

Shifting tests from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 with v4 formula increases blocking findings from 42 to 99 changes (3.4% → 8.0%, operator-accepted) with zero demotions of currently-blocking findings
New forbids_contract_allowed_state binary with both-halves-verbatim evidence and stated-tightening guard must be added to CodeSeverityAttrs and code-review-tests.md antipattern list

Prod_impact and trigger_likelihood field descriptions must be re-scoped in verify_models.py and code-review-verify.md to document that for coverage/contract findings they measure guarded-path user-reach (replacing test-only⇒none clause) and trigger frequency, replacing the v3 discard behavior
